en: Sepia-toned landscape view of a hillside town with many villas and houses scattered among trees. On the hilltop to the left stands a small castle-like building, and further along the ridge are towers and other structures. In the foreground is a church or chapel with a bell tower. The image has a white border with scalloped edges, and cursive text is printed along the bottom margin.
